messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 4 - no logbook found
parts:
Dear Pieter-Jan,

I see in the config.csv that you used idloc = 5 which extracts the ID as the character string before the first space. For the example file you sent this would be P2021001_fu1. However, in the sleep log you sent I see P2021001 as ID. So, it sounds like you need idloc = 2 to split the ID as the character string before the first underscore.

Alternatively, update the sleeplog to match these extended IDs.

Best,

Vincent

On Wednesday, 12 February 2025 at 9:56 AM, Pieter-Jan Marent <marentp...@gmail.com> wrote:
Dear all

When running a previous successful script with new data, I noticed that part 4 won't use my provided logbook as a guider anymore (it seems to be unable to find it, as cleaning code = 1). I'm still using GGIR v3.1-4 as I need consistency with my previous runs (longitudinal data).

Anyone else encountered issues with GGIR reading the simple logbook?

Attached an example to reproduce.
Data file: P2021001_fu1 (2022-07-31).gt3x

Thanks in advance!
Pieter-Jan Marent
